armor_set.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.ni: Pitch-black armor worn by riders who hunted beneath a moonless sky.
Increases movement speed by 20%. At night, also grants Night Vision.
armor_set.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.bl: Cold plate and weathered fur, bearing the oath of a shadow bound to an Empyrean.
armor_set.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.cr: Primeval gold shaped for those who served the Crucible before the Erdtree.
Grants Resistance while the complete set is worn.
Ancient armor marked by the branching life of the primordial Crucible.
Grants Fire Resistance while the complete set is worn.
armor_set.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.tr: Burnished gold of the mounted guardians who never abandoned their watch.
Grants Absorption that renews every 10 seconds.
armor_set.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.ma: Black iron and faded gold, heavy with the memory of Destined Death.
weapon.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.nagak: An exceptionally long katana with fearsome reach.
Its slender blade rewards swift and deliberate strikes.
Hits build up Blood Loss. The 4th hit within 5 seconds bursts for 12% of the target's max health.
weapon.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.night: A hooked polearm blackened by endless midnight hunts.
Its edge seems to drink the warmth from fleeing prey.
At night, hits have a chance to slow the target.
weapon.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.blaid: A moon-cold blade carried by a shadow sworn to royal fate.
The oath remains, even where its master has fallen silent.
Hits have a chance to heavily slow the target.
armor_set.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.ro: Weathered armor worn by a masterless warrior who walks beneath no banner.
Blocking an attack with a shield grants Strength for 4 seconds.
weapon.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.cruci: Ancient red-gold shaped before the Erdtree claimed the age.
Its weight carries the fury of primordial life.
Hits have a chance to violently knock enemies away.
weapon.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.tree_: A gilded halberd borne by guardians of the Erdtree.
Its blessing favors warriors who enter battle unbroken.
At high health, hits can grant brief absorption.
weapon.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.malik: A blackened blade bound around a stolen fragment of death.
Even a shallow wound remembers the end of all things.
Hits have a chance to afflict the target with Wither.
shield.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.cruci: A greatshield crowned by a horn of the primordial Crucible.
Its brutal silhouette turns defense into a threat.
Blocking a melee attack throws the attacker back.
shield.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.tree_: A radiant shield carried by the Erdtree's mounted sentinels.
Its gold has outlasted kingdoms and countless sieges.
Blocking an attack grants brief Absorption.
relic.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.night_: A black iron badge worn by riders who hunted after dusk.
The metal remains unnaturally cold beneath moonlight.
relic.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.royal_: A pale shard carrying the memory of a shadow's oath.
Frost gathers along its edge even beside a flame.
relic.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.crucib: A red-gold scale shed by life touched by the Crucible.
Its branching ridges pulse like a buried root.
relic.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.erdtre: A gilded crest once fastened to a sentinel's war gear.
A fading blessing still clings to its engraved boughs.
Bastion treasure rooms and desert pyramids
relic.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.destin: A splinter of black-red power severed from a sealed rune.
Nearby light dims as though fearful of its touch.
End cities and ancient city ice boxes
relic.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.soul_i: A wandering spirit sealed within clouded glass.
Its pale light stirs with every distant wail.
armor_set.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.ra: Red-gold warplate worn by the lion general who challenged the very stars.
Gravity Crash: landing from a fall of 4+ blocks sends out a shockwave that damages and launches nearby enemies.
weapon.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.stars: Black steel greatswords once wielded by Radahn in his prime.
Their slashes are answered moments later by Miquella's searing light.
Right-click to chain up to 3 slashes. Delayed pillars of light follow each strike; the final cross-slash launches nearby foes.
relic.soulscraft_tarnished_legacy.fallin: A dense remnant chipped from a star that never reached the earth.
Dust and loose iron creep toward it when no hand is near.
